title: Fixed finite quantified-word collapse and optimum moves
claims: FiniteQuantifiedWordCollapse characterizes P = NP by polynomial-time decidability after arbitrary fixed finite polynomially bounded word quantification.
FiniteQuantifiedWordOptimalMove derives a shortest, lexicographically least move or universal counterexample under P = NP.
P_subset_NP is independently checked against the pinned definitions.
